rationale: The 08:30 US data release re-prices the market and the range of the first 15 minutes after the 08:25 start is the market's first agreed price, so a volume-backed break of it before 09:25 carries into the 09:30 open as positioning completes, most on days with a tier-1 release; the main setting is the day set (every day, any 08:30-release day, tier-1 release day). Losing side: Traders who fade the first break of the post-release range and are stopped as the release direction carries.

filter.plain: only when the bar that just closed has more volume than the median of the same clock bar over the 14 days before
